title: Saudi Arabian Cucumber Kebabs
description: A refreshing and flavorful kebab recipe inspired by Saudi Arabian cuisine, featuring zesty cucumber and succulent skewers.

ingredients.name: Zesty sauce (such as tahini or tzatziki)
Arabian spice blend
ingredients.notes: or any combination of cumin, coriander, and sumac

instructions: 2. Cut the cucumber into 1-inch pieces and thread them onto the skewers.
3. In a small bowl, mix together the zesty sauce and Arabian spice blend.
4. Brush the skewers with the zesty sauce mixture, making sure they're fully coated.
5. Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they're tender and lightly charred.
6. Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
